evidence: Clean data only; approved bounded yearly changes are generated with fixed seeds
Q2-M1 averages 20 scenario parameters and solves one deterministic MILP; it is not the approved shared-decision scenario stochastic MILP
The objective therefore is not the scenario average of piecewise surplus-sale profit
Endpoint stress scenarios required by the code plan are absent
The water-mode hard-constraint defect is inherited
Optimization and test seeds are explicit
No endpoint-stress table, seed-stability file, distribution-sensitivity file or solver-metrics file
Fallback tail-change test subtracts a value from itself and can never detect tail sensitivity
All Q2 schedules have 8-13 water-mode violations under the missing check
Independent water-mode audit found violations in every Q2 schedule
Zero-surplus main and baseline hit 40 seconds with gaps of 6.25% and 4.35%

findings.finding: Mean-parameter optimization is mislabeled as scenario stochastic MILP.
findings.recommended_action: Build scenario-specific production, normal-sales and profit variables while retaining shared x/z decisions, or explicitly change the approved method through a new human decision.

findings.finding: The inherited water-mode formulation and verifier accept illegal schedules.
findings.recommended_action: Fix the shared formulation and verifier before any Q2 performance comparison.

findings.finding: Evaluation repeatedly filters pandas frames inside year-crop-scenario loops, causing most of the long aggregation time.
findings.recommended_action: Precompute sparse area matrices and vectorize scenario profit evaluation with NumPy; cache production and weighted prices once per schedule.

findings.finding: The model is rebuilt four times from scratch and does not reuse the constraint matrix or incumbents.
findings.recommended_action: Build the structural matrix once, change objective/right-hand sides per sale rule, warm-start from baseline where supported, and solve the easier half-price case first.
